verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm docs name the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) as a supported part and list ROCm 7.2.1 for Radeon 9000 Series. The Radeon ROCm page states vLLM has 'full support' and llama.cpp is 'supported for efficient inference', with vLLM and SGLang setup guides, so the serving-stack half of the story is documented first-party. Nothing in the pack covers FP8/FP4 for this part, and the serving-stack claims are made for Radeon 9000 broadly rather than for this card specifically. Missing for 10: documented FP8/FP4 low-precision inference support on this part, a per-part vLLM/llama.cpp compatibility listing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of LLM inference on the RX 9070 XT.
